Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Ananya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Naira - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Ayaan stands in the snow. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ayaan builds a snowman.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Ayaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Ayaan: "Careful!"

[Ayaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Hema (happily): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Look over here."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Ayaan (excited): "Oh wow!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Ayaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
